question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

I told Jack that we seen a good film last week with our friends from Mexico.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"seen a good film last."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"seen a good film last."**
 
• The past tense of **"see"** is** "saw," **so the corrected sentence maintains proper grammar.
 
• The correction involves changing** "seen"** to** "saw"** to use the correct past tense of the verb.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence:* I told Jack that we **saw a good film last**__ week with our friends from Mexico.*
